text:
maria: quick heads-up — backend team merged the v1->v2 param rename ("model" -> "model_id") earlier today. we need redirects + SDK snippet updates in docs.

devin: ack. which pages are high priority?

maria: the migration guide, quickstart JS/py snippets, and the embedding examples. also any code samples that still show `model:` inline in tutorial apps.

alisha: timeline? customers flagged a breaking change in sandbox tests this morning. want to coordinate a soft revert vs docs-only patch.

maria: ops says the server change stays. goal is to have docs + SDK patch out in <48h and a small comms note.

leo: I can run a grep across the `docs` site and open a single PR that replaces `model:` -> `model_id:` in inline snippets, but we should be careful about example outputs. some snippets use `model` in prose.

qa_josh: found 2 failing smoke tests in `examples/todo-app` and `notebooks/embeddings-quickstart.ipynb`. stack traces show TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'model'.

maria: thanks Josh — please paste the failing snippet here.

qa_josh: paste: ```python
# failing call
client.generate(model="rwd-1-large", prompt="hi")
```

devin: ok update is simple. new call should be: ```python
client.generate(model_id="rwd-1-large", prompt="hi")
```

alisha: do we need to change SDK param aliases or keep a compat shim?

devin: we're shipping a thin shim in SDK v2.1.1 that maps `model` -> `model_id` with a DeprecationWarning. still want docs to show the new `model_id` everywhere.

leo: checklist for the PR: grep changes, update fenced code blocks, update inline prose, add a small note in migration guide explaining aliasing and timeline, and add redirect rules for docs links that referenced v1 param names.

maria: can someone own the migration-guide paragraph? I can draft the text but need someone to review for accuracy.

alisha: I can review. Maria, draft and @me.

devin: I'll draft SDK changelog entry and the compat-shim release note.

qa_josh: after updates i'll re-run smoke tests and post results.

leo: opening PR now: `docs: replace model -> model_id in snippets + migration note` — will push a branch and tag reviewers @maria @alisha @devin.

maria: thanks. also add an explicit example for function calling showing `model_id` and explain the deprecation window, e.g.,,

maria: "We recommend migrating to `model_id` by 2026-05-15. The SDK will accept `model` until then but will emit a warning"

devin: can we include this short example in the migration guide? ```js
// before
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rwd-chat-lite', messages });
// after
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model_id: 'rwd-chat-lite', messages });
```

leo: PR #4321 opened. CI running (lint + smoke). tag: `docs-migration-model-param`

deploy-bot: docs-site staging deploy started for branch `docs-migration-model-param`

qa_josh: smoke tests failed initially (same TypeError) — looks like some examples were missed in `examples/quickstarts/ts`. re-run queued after patch.

devin: pushed a tiny patch to the branch fixing TS examples, and added a README note for snippet owners.

maria: once CI green, we want to merge and then cut an emergency patch release for SDK so new installs get the shim. devex, can you update the snippets in the SDK repo too?

devin: will do. planning to release v2.1.1 with the shim and changelog in ~2 hours after merge.

leo: CI green. merging in 2 min.

deploy-bot: docs-site staging deploy succeeded — https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/migration/model-param

qa_josh: reran smoke tests — all passing now. :tada:

maria: awesome. thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer-facing blurb for the status page and the in-console banner. @alisha please review tone.

alisha: will do, aiming to ship the blurb in next 30m.

devin: release v2.1.1 published, includes compat shim + changelog. npm and pip artifacts available.

maria: closing loop — create a short follow-up thread for post-mortem to capture why the param rename landed without docs sync. put lessons learned (pre-merge doc checklist) in the PR template.

leo: added `docs-checklist` item to PR template in the branch.

maria: :shipit:
